name: isle-web
description: The admin panel (apps/panel) and the player site (apps/portal) in React, shared code in web/packages/*.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/panel/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/portal/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:panel: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/panel/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:portal: npm run typecheck && vite build --config apps/portal/vite.config.ts
